name: crew
description: Makes the main session a lead that delegates to six specialist subagents: code-reader and research on Haiku; designer, developer and tester on Sonnet; architect on Opus. With a TypeSafe key, Jev may move each call's model one step (the architect stays on Opus) and raise its effort to high; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai.

jevRouting.title: Jev routing of model and effort
jevRouting.description: Lets Jev (TypeSafe) choose the model and effort of each crew:* Agent call, one step from the agent's default and never below the architect's Opus floor or medium effort, and shows the choice in the task's description. On by default, but nothing is sent without a TypeSafe key: with one, the call's description and its prompt (secrets and paths removed, cut to 4000 characters) are sent to api.typesafe.ai. The agent type is never changed, and a call that names a model keeps it. A repository's own settings cannot turn it on.

jevKey.title: Jev API key (TypeSafe)
jevKey.description: Last fallback for the TypeSafe key, used only when jevRouting is on: TYPESAFE_API_KEY, JEV_API_KEY and ~/.jev-router.env are read first. The key is sent only in the Authorization header to api.typesafe.ai and is never logged or stored by the plugin.
